notes: The sources the game draws on and acknowledges: the pause menu's Credits screen (game/scripts/ui/hud.gd) shows every entry, in this order. This file is the only list; no scene or script repeats it.

An entry: id, title, credit (the line to show), licence and url (empty if none), required (true where the licence asks for the acknowledgement, false where it is a courtesy) and used_for. Optional: licence_file, a licence text that ships with the game and shows under the entry (export_presets.cfg's include_filter must list it); engine, for Godot Engine, whose own licence and its third-party notices come from Engine.get_license_text(), get_copyright_info() and get_license_info() under the screen's Godot Engine licences button; loading_screen, a credit the loading screen shows too; folders, the project folders the entry covers.

game/tests/headless_credits_contract.gd fails when a folder under game/ or generated/ holds a licence or provenance file (LICENSE, LICENCE, COPYING, NOTICE, PROVENANCE, ATTRIBUTION, AUTHORS, OFL), fonts, sounds, videos or 3D models, or sits directly in a vendor, addons or third_party folder, and is listed neither in an entry's folders nor in own_work (things made in this project, which need no credit). It fails too when a listed folder is gone.

Not listed because nothing of them ships: reference photos and Street View (looked at, never in the game), the Kenney Nature Kit and the NAIP-placed placeholder vegetation (both removed), and the npm packages and tools that generate the world offline.

entries.title: OpenStreetMap
entries.used_for: The island's layout: its shoreline, roads, paths, parks and every building's footprint (August 2026 snapshot), and the coasts, bridges and waterfronts on the horizon.

entries.title: Godot Engine
entries.credit: This game uses Godot Engine, available under the MIT licence.
entries.used_for: The game engine. Its full licence and the software by other authors it includes, with their licences, are under Godot Engine licences.

entries.title: Godot 4 Third Person Controller (touch controls)
entries.used_for: The touch screen's stick and buttons, and their art, adapted.

entries.title: USGS 3D Elevation Program
entries.credit: Elevation data: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
entries.used_for: The height of the ground on Treasure Island and Yerba Buena Island (the 1 m elevation model of 2023).

entries.title: Aerial imagery
entries.credit: Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
entries.licence: Esri World Imagery terms of use
entries.used_for: Tree positions, Yerba Buena Island's plant cover and some ground and shoreline shapes were read from the aerial photo of 26 May 2026 (World Imagery Wayback). None of the imagery itself is in the game.

entries.title: Poly Haven
entries.credit: Textures from Poly Haven: clean_asphalt, concrete_pavement, concrete_floor_03, sparse_grass, plaster_grey_04 and bitumen
entries.used_for: Road asphalt, pavements and paved areas, the grass detail, wall plaster and flat roofs.

entries.title: Public art
entries.credit: Point of Infinity by Hiroshi Sugimoto (Yerba Buena Island); Canopy of Sky by Ned Kahn (Cityside Park)
entries.used_for: Modelled after the real works, which stand on the islands.
